title: Package Guildhall-owned dirty checkout work into resumable task checkpoints
description: When worktree isolation is disabled or Guildhall has already dirtied a shared checkout, Guildhall should take responsibility for that state by packaging task-owned work into a resumable branch or commit checkpoint instead of treating the dirty repo as an external blocker forever.
outOfScope: Auto-merging shared-checkout work straight to main with no review

acceptanceCriteria.description: Guildhall can distinguish likely Guildhall-owned dirty state from unrelated user dirt and surface a resumable checkpoint path instead of a generic repo-dirty stop
Shared-checkout task work can be packaged into a task-owned branch or commit checkpoint without sweeping unrelated project metadata

notes.content: Shared-checkout tasks now checkpoint their own dirty work into a task branch when they reach done with worktree isolation disabled, instead of only recording 'merge skipped'. The git driver also resolves the true git toplevel for nested project paths so Guildhall state files at repo root are ignored during cleanliness checks and left out of checkpoint commits.

Verified with git-driver/orchestrator coverage and a live Fair Labor License replay: Guildhall now treats its own shared-checkout dirt as resumable task-owned state, and stale review-handoff blockers from that era reopen cleanly instead of leaving the queue terminal.
